methods.name: self_heal_dropbear
methods.description: Checks and restarts the dropbear SSH process if it is not running or not listening on expected interfaces and addresses, with variations based on platform and configuration.

methods.name: self_heal_ccspwifissp_hung
methods.description: Monitors the WiFi SSP process and restarts it if it appears hung, particularly when the associated process is not responsive or reporting errors.

methods.name: self_heal_nas_ip
methods.description: Addresses an issue where NAS IP is incorrectly set to loopback by reassigning it to the current WAN interface IP, specific to certain models.

methods.name: self_heal_dhcpmgr
methods.description: Ensures that the DHCP Manager process is running, restarting it if it is not.

methods.name: wan_sysevents
methods.description: Triggers system events to restart or check the WAN interface.

methods.name: self_heal_wan
methods.description: Detects if the WAN status is stuck in 'starting' and performs system logs collection and recovery attempts.

methods.name: self_heal_sedaemon
methods.description: Restarts specific system daemons related to security and access management.

methods.name: self_heal_conntrack
methods.description: Checks the system's conntrack table size and logs if it has reached maximum capacity.
